bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
rid=req_c80c95b3bc35f97c57dbf471
printf 'HOST_CHECKOUT_HEAD='
git -C /home/admin1/server-core rev-parse HEAD
for entry in 'SINK:/home/admin1/logs/servercore-bounded-results' 'WRITER:/home/admin1/logs/servercore-service-deploy'; do
  name="${entry%%:*}"
  root="${entry#*:}"
  target="$root/$rid.json"
  if test -f "$target" && ! test -L "$target"; then
    printf '%s_RECORD=EXISTS\n' "$name"
    if test "$name" = SINK; then
      python3 - "$target" <<'GACE_READ'
import json,sys
try:
    r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1],encoding="utf-8"))
    for k in ("request_id","command_id","state","exit_code","published","recorded_at","attempts"):
        print("SINK_"+k.upper()+"="+str(r.get(k,"UNKNOWN"))[:100])
except (OSError,ValueError,TypeError):
    print("SINK_RECORD=UNREADABLE")
GACE_READ
    fi
  else
    printf '%s_RECORD=ABSENT_OR_NONREGULAR\n' "$name"
  fi
done
if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf 'JOURNAL_MATCHES='
  (journalctl --user --since '2026-10-27 13:15:00 UTC' --until '2026-10-27 13:32:00 UTC' -o cat --no-pager 2>/dev/null | grep -Fc "$rid") || true
fi
